title: REQ · Every object and action is reachable by keyboard and screen reader from game state
summary: Tab, arrows, Enter and Space reach each object and action, with a live region and ARIA labels from game state.
description: Context: BootScene.onKeyDown moves focus with Tab/arrows, writes focusedObjectId to the store, and Enter/Space activate the focused object via objectClick. Nothing announces the focus and the DOM has no labelled list of objects. Desired: the overlay region has role=group with aria-label from the object name, buttons carry aria-label like 'Inspect Old Bookshelf', Enter on a focused object moves DOM focus to its first action button, Tab/arrows/Enter/Space then work between action buttons, Escape closes via menuClose, and an aria-live=polite region announces the focused object and its actions from the same store state. Expected result: usable without a mouse or sight. Why: Done-when 3.9.
acceptance_criteria: Given focusedObjectId changes to bookshelf, When the live region renders, Then it contains the object name and its action labels
Given an object is selected, When the overlay renders, Then each button has an aria-label combining action label and object name
Given focus is on an action button, When Enter or Space is pressed, Then game.act is called for that action
Given the overlay is open, When Escape is pressed, Then menuClose clears the selection

out_of_scope: Screen-reader testing in a real browser

technical_constraints: Labels come from the same game state and content as the visuals
definition_of_done: Live region and labels implemented in ObjectOverlay
